errors.name: AllowanceNotCleared
errors.message: Safety check: an allowance survived the trade, so the whole trade was reverted. Report this.

errors.name: AmountTooLarge
errors.message: The amount is too large to encode (above uint128 for pool swaps, or overflowing the native scale).

errors.name: NativeTransferFailed
errors.message: The native USDC transfer to the owner failed (for example a blocklisted owner, or an owner contract that refuses USDC).

errors.name: NotFactory
errors.message: Only the agent account factory can do this.

errors.name: NotGraduated
errors.message: The token has not graduated; trade it on its curve with buy or sell.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.message: Only the account owner can do this.

errors.name: NotTrading
errors.message: The curve is not trading: it sold out, is graduating, or has graduated. Use swapExactIn once it has graduated.

errors.name: PriceImpactTooHigh
errors.message: This trade would move the price by 12500000 bps, above maxPriceImpactBps. Trade a smaller size.

errors.name: SafeERC20FailedOperation
errors.message: A token transfer or approval of 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a0 failed.

errors.name: SelfReferrer
errors.message: The referrer cannot be the account itself.

errors.name: SnipeTaxTooHigh
errors.message: The launch snipe tax is 12500000 bps, above this account limit (maxSnipeBps). Wait for it to decay.

errors.name: TokenNotAllowed
errors.message: The account is in allowlist mode and this token is not on the owner allowlist. Sells stay open.

errors.name: TokenNotRegistered
errors.message: The token is not a Mercurifi Launch token on this network.

errors.name: TokenTooNew
errors.message: The token is younger than the account minimum token age (minTokenAgeBlocks).

errors.name: TradeTooLarge
errors.message: Above the per-trade limit of 12.5 USDC (maxTradeUsdc). Sells count at cost basis, launches include the launch fee.

errors.name: UnexpectedPool
errors.message: The graduated pool is not the LaunchHook USDC pool for this token; the account refuses to trade it.

errors.name: UnexpectedSwapDelta
errors.message: Safety check: the pool swap moved more or returned less than asked, so the whole swap was reverted. Report this.

errors.name: ZeroAddress
errors.message: An address argument is the zero address.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.message: The amount is zero or rounds to zero.

errors.name: ZeroMinOut
errors.message: The minimum output must be above zero.

errors.name: ZeroOutput
errors.message: The trade would return nothing at the current price.

errors.name: AcceptRequired
errors.message: An ownership transfer completes only when the new owner calls acceptOwnership.

errors.name: ActionLimit
errors.message: The account has used all its actions for this period (maxActionsPerPeriod).

errors.name: AgentAlreadyActive
errors.message: That agent is already active; use setAgent to change its terms.

errors.name: AgentExpired
errors.message: This agent key has expired. The owner can extend it (a queued change) or add a new key.

errors.name: AgentExpiryOutOfRange
errors.message: The agent expiry must be after now and at most 180 days away.

errors.name: AgentNotActive
errors.message: That address is not an active agent; use addAgent.

errors.name: AgentRetired
errors.message: That address was revoked before and can never be an agent of this account again.

errors.name: BetaCeiling
errors.message: The policy field periodSellCap is above the beta ceiling of this factory.

errors.name: DeadlineOutOfRange
errors.message: The deadline is outside [now, now + maxDeadlineSeconds]. The SDK builds deadlines from chain time; a custom deadline must respect the account limit.

errors.name: DelayOutOfRange
errors.message: The widening delay must be at most seven days.

errors.name: InvalidAgent
errors.message: The agent key cannot be zero, the owner or the account itself.

errors.name: InvalidOwner
errors.message: The new owner cannot be zero, the account itself or the current owner.

errors.name: InvalidPermissions
errors.message: The permissions are empty or contain an unknown bit.

errors.name: InvalidPolicy
errors.message: The policy field periodSellCap is out of range (a bps field above 10,000, or a deadline outside 1–600 s).

errors.name: LaunchLimit
errors.message: The account has used all its launches for this period (launchesPerPeriod).

errors.name: MissingPermission
errors.message: This agent key does not have the permission this action needs.

errors.name: NotAccount
errors.message: The caller is not a registered agent account of this factory.

errors.name: NotAgent
errors.message: This key is not an active agent of the account: never added, revoked, or its addition is still queued.

errors.name: NotPendingOwner
errors.message: Only the proposed new owner of this queued transfer can accept it.

errors.name: Paused
errors.message: Agent actions are paused, by the account owner or by the platform guardian pause (at most 72 h).

errors.name: PeriodOutOfRange
errors.message: The usage period must be between one hour and seven days.

errors.name: PeriodSellExceeded
errors.message: Above the period sell cap. Sells are valued at the higher of the average and the high-water cost basis. Remaining this period: 12.5 USDC.

errors.name: PeriodSpendExceeded
errors.message: Above the period spend cap. Remaining this period: 12.5 USDC.

errors.name: QueuedExpired
errors.message: This queued change expired 7 days after its ETA. Cancel it and queue it again.

errors.name: StaleQueued
errors.message: The subject of this queued change (the agent, the token's allowlist entry or the delay) was changed after it was queued, so it no longer applies. Queue it again.

errors.name: TokenCapExceeded
errors.message: Above the per-token period cap. Remaining for this token: 12.5 USDC.

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.message: This queued change can run from 2027-01-15T08:00:00.000Z.

errors.name: TooManyAgents
errors.message: The account already has eight active agents. Revoke one first.

errors.name: UnknownQueued
errors.message: No queued change has id 12500000 (never queued, already executed or cancelled).

errors.name: AccountExists
errors.message: An account already exists at 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a0 for this owner and salt; use another salt.

errors.name: FailedDeployment
errors.message: The account clone could not be deployed.

errors.name: GuardianDisabled
errors.message: This factory has no guardian; no pause can be started.

errors.name: ImplementationMismatch
errors.message: The implementation is not bound to this factory and its registry.

errors.name: InvalidCeiling
errors.message: The beta ceiling for periodSellCap is out of range.

errors.name: NoActivePause
errors.message: There is no active pause to extend.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.message: Only the factory admin (the Launch timelock) can do this.

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.message: Only the guardian can do this.

errors.name: PauseCooldown
errors.message: The guardian pause is cooling down until 2027-01-15T08:00:00.000Z.

errors.name: PauseTooLong
errors.message: The pause may last at most until 2027-01-15T08:00:00.000Z.

errors.name: Expired
errors.message: The deadline passed before the transaction was included.

errors.name: InitialBuyTooLarge
errors.message: The initial buy is above the launch cap (maxInitialBuyTokens).

errors.name: InsufficientGasForGraduation
errors.message: This buy completes the curve and needs more gas for graduation. The SDK sends at least 1,800,000 gas for such buys.

errors.name: Slippage
errors.message: The price moved past your minimum output. Re-quote and retry, or allow more slippage.

errors.name: ConfigChanged
errors.message: The Launch config changed between the quote and inclusion. Re-read the config and retry.

errors.name: InsufficientLaunchFee
errors.message: The value sent does not cover the launch fee.

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.message: The name must be 1–32 bytes, the symbol 1–10 bytes and the metadata URI at most 256 bytes.

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.message: There are no fees to claim.

errors.name: PartialFill
errors.message: The pool cannot fill this whole amount within its price bounds. Trade a smaller size.

errors.name: ERC20InsufficientBalance
errors.message: The account does not hold enough of this token.

errors.name: V4TooLittleReceived
errors.message: The pool output was below the minimum (slippage). Re-quote and retry.
